field.label: URL Key
field.comment: Map an Ergonode Text attribute or let Magento generate URL Key from the product name. Magento normalizes mapped values and updates URL rewrites.

field.label: Price
field.comment: Map Price from Ergonode or keep it managed by Magento. Magento-managed Price is not mapped or published to Ergonode; the default is used only when synchronization creates a Magento product.

field.label: Default Price
field.comment: Required non-negative decimal value assigned when synchronization creates a Magento product.
field.tooltip: The default Magento value is assigned only when synchronization creates a product. It is never used to update an existing product.

field.label: Status
field.comment: Map Status from Ergonode or keep it managed by Magento. Magento-managed Status is not mapped or published to Ergonode; the default is used only when synchronization creates a Magento product.

field.label: Default Status
field.comment: Value assigned when synchronization creates a Magento product.
field.tooltip: The default Magento value is assigned only when synchronization creates a product. It is never used to update an existing product.

field.label: Default Visibility
field.comment: Value assigned when synchronization creates a Magento product.
field.tooltip: The default Magento value is assigned only when synchronization creates a product. It is never used to update an existing product.
